items.a: Global Consensus Value is a community-proposed price target — 1 π ≈ $314,159 — used consistently across the GCV Market. It is not an official Pi Network rate and is not endorsed by the Pi Core Team or verified on any exchange; Pi's actual open-market price is far lower.

items.q: How do I join the Alliance?
items.a: Register as a member to browse and buy in the GCV Market, or register your business as a GCV Merchant. Use the form below or the Register button in the navigation.
Physical products can be returned within 30 days. Digital products are non-refundable once accessed. See our terms for details.

items.q: How can I become an Ambassador?
items.a: Contact us to learn about our Ambassador programme. We're always looking for passionate members to help grow the Alliance in their region.
